fixed_broader_challenge.scope: Post-hoc fixed diagnostic; all committed programs replayed, no learning/controller execution, original results unchanged.

findings: No neural superiority: all three spiking models accept2/8; conventional relatedness, frozen-input control and linear model accept3/8 each.
Every proposed program fails the fixed broader-domain exact challenge. The narrow original acceptance does not establish useful domain generalization.
Bounded work-fair scheduling is implemented consistently across methods and counters reconcile; this audit checks recorded counters/settings, not original controller visitation or CPU measurements.
Same8 development cases were adapted across revisions. No unseen qualification and no evidence of consciousness or a broadly superior neural planner.
limits: Search, training gradients, model scoring and original in-memory scorer invocation were not re-executed.
Core commitment binds output, inputs and planner configuration but omits scorer-model identity/multiplier; trace/model association is checked separately.
Virtual-work accounting is not complete hardware FLOPs or wall-time comparability.
A source-bound macro ancestry list alone does not prove causal necessity.
